module "M_MaterialIntoPin.dss"

product 0 Material "M_MaterialIntoPin" backend=Graph
  %0 = Constant(Value=(1, 0, 0)) : float3 @L7:C19 "BaseColor"
  %1 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L8:C19 "Roughness"
  %2 = MakeMaterialAttributes(BaseColor=%0, Roughness=%1) : material @L9:C48 "Opacity"
  %3 = Constant(Value=(0.25)) : float @L9:C66 "Opacity"
  %4 = Reflected[BlendMaterialAttributes](A=%2, B=%2, Alpha=%3) : material @L9:C17 "Opacity"
  %5 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%4) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L9:C17 "Opacity"
  %6 = MaterialSink(BaseColor=%0, Roughness=%1, Opacity=%5#2) @L5:C1
  sink %6
